_description: Plant functional group (PFG) model. Sensitivities s[action] are the share of occupancy lost per operation of intensity 1, set from growth form and regeneration strategy (annual ruderals regrow from the seed bank; perennial grasses such as Imperata resprout from rhizomes and tolerate fire; shrubs, climbers and tree seedlings are killed by slashing). colonisation and shade_beta are calibrated against the thesis plots (hbabm.pfg_model.calibrate); the values below are the starting priors.

calibration._targets_note: Mixes follow the survey: 2 of 16 production-forest managers grow acacia monocultures; 64% of the protection-forest mowing records report no cutting (share_not_cut in data/processed/management_by_land_use.csv).
